name: CPU page: how much of each audio block the audio takes, with the Track FX' and the effect slots' shares
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (notes/78): built once into cpu.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build when the CPU card is ticked (compose.py --cpu), with or without packages. The audio interrupt's call of the audio function (0x40059382, jsr 0x4005979e) goes to the part's probe, which times it with the DMA timer 0 (90 112 ticks a block) and keeps, over windows of 750 blocks (0.5 s), the average share of a block and the dearest block, the dearest block since the page last cleared it, and the shares the build's other parts measure: the Track FX' (fltslot's last average, whose address the composer writes into the data block, 0 without Track FX) and the effect slots' (fxslot's running ticks since its 0.7, 0 without effects). Since 0.2 (step 2 of notes/78 §6) the device configuration list (0x40032aee) ends with the row CPU, which opens a page of its own, the stock machine-select page with a private copy of its vtables (Model-TG's System page, TinyGregAudio, MIT): CPU with a bar, PEAK, TRACK FX and EFFECTS; Return closes it. Since 0.3 (step 3) the page redraws itself twice a second from its own periodic method (the view stack's +0x2c), and PEAK counts from its opening.
